title: Creative Presentation Designer
note: Pitch-deck and sponsorship design for the club's Corporate Partnerships team; asks for about 2 years of design experience.

facts.summary: Full-time designer on Chicago Fire FC's Corporate Partnerships team making sales and sponsorship presentation materials.
facts.duties: Design sales decks, sponsorship proposals, one-sheets, sponsor mockups and signage concepts, turn data into infographics, and build reusable templates.
facts.requirements: About 2+ years of graphic design (sports, agency or marketing a plus); strong InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop and PowerPoint; good layout and typography; bachelor's or equivalent experience.
facts.apply: Apply through the club's TeamWork Online posting (linked from the Mediabistro listing).
